provenance: All cases below are synthetic, specified by mathematical model, not inferred measurements.
epsilon_meaning: Illustrative deterministic per-reading perturbation bound, not a validated uncertainty bound, standard deviation, or confidence interval.

cases.name: production_only
cases.expected: Calibrated point estimate attributes raw doubling to production; illustrative bounded-error production interval excludes 1.

cases.name: gain_only
cases.expected: Same raw sample doubling as production-only, but calibrated point estimate gives no production change; sensitivity interval includes 1.

cases.name: cancellation
cases.expected: Equal background-corrected sample readings hide production doubling; calibration recovers it noiselessly, but the chosen conservative epsilon can leave no-change unresolved.

cases.name: small_effect
cases.expected: Small point change is not distinguishable in the illustrative sensitivity envelope.

cases.name: weak_calibration
cases.expected: Return inconclusive when the standard-minus-blank difference is at or below twice epsilon.

cases.name: matrix_mismatch
cases.expected: If sample gain doubles while calibrator gain stays fixed, true unchanged production appears to double. The algorithm cannot diagnose an undisclosed transfer failure from these six readings.
